memberdef.name: sstep_pwm_write_fn

briefdescription.para: Write the PWM compare values of all legs.

detaileddescription.para:
Called from sstep_fast_loop().
context
sstep_callbacks::context.
compare
One compare value per leg, 0 .. pwm_period_ticks (0 = low-side on, pwm_period_ticks = high-side on). Entries above the leg count of the topology are 0. Valid only during the call.
0
Success.
<0
Error: the driver switches the outputs off with SSTEP_FAULT_HAL.
